verdict.rationale: LM Studio exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API/server (both GUI and headless 'llmster' modes) that third-party tools built for OpenAI-style backends can target, and community feedback confirms the server is easy to spin up for testing with external tools. However, there's no direct evidence of Claude Code or Codex specifically being validated against LM Studio's backend, and some users note friction (no local-network exposure clarity, no pure daemon mode complaints) that could affect agent-tool integration.
